Domain semantics (physics/math claims) are strictly stripped and relegated to domain adapters.

sources.invariants: Associativity of operator composition; rank-nullity theorem; commutator zero condition for reordering.

sources.invariants: Strict boundary: observed quantity != inferred generator; non-zero null space prevents claiming identified source.
sources.v2_disposition: ADOPT StateProjection, Observation, and InverseProjection; enforce separation of observation from inference.
